checks.name: P1 solo, unchanged: with no other player (no list, or an empty one) every tick of seven scripts - stand, walk, sprint, crouch-walk, a vault, a crawl through a wall hole, sprint + slide - is identical, number for number, to HQ1's move.js
P2 sprinting into a standing player at 30, 60, 120, 144, 240, 360 FPS and a jittered schedule: the same trace tick for tick (240 fixed ticks); never closer than D; stopped at contact

P3 the server agrees: every position a page would send (every third tick, whole px) is a free move under the server's own rule - head-on, past his shoulder, round him, dead centre, into a crowd of five: no correction at all with no lag

P4 the slide: 12 px off his line on open floor she slides round him and gets past (never closer than D); past his shoulder in the corridor when he stands aside; dead centre she stops at contact and is never pushed sideways
P4 a sprint-slide into a standing player dies at contact, as against a wall (never closer than D, on her own side)

P5 the vault: with nobody there it vaults the counter; with a player standing on the landing it does not start (she stays on her side, never closer than D); with a player beside the run-up, not in the way, it still vaults
